title: Five day size exchange

posts.caption:
Wrong size? You have five days from delivery to swap it.
Keep the pair unworn, in the original box, with the DAUR SUPPLY UNIT seal attached. Send it back with the courier of your choice; once it reaches us and passes the check, your new size is dispatched. The return courier is paid by the customer.
Sale pairs are final for size. Defects in normal wear are covered for 30 days.
#DAURSupply #MensShoes #Pakistan
